consent_description: We count page views without storing anything on your device. With your agreement, PostHog keeps one cookie to link the pages you visit.
consent_section_intro_text: Your choice is kept for six months and can be changed at any time from "Cookie settings" at the bottom of every page.
consent_cat_necessary_text: Remembers your choice about cookies (cookie cc_cookie, six months). Always on, no tracking.
consent_cat_analytics_text: Links the pages you view on this site, and your sign-up if you create an account, to see which pages help and where visitors leave.
consent_cat_marketing_text: Measures the effectiveness of our campaigns.
consent_cat_thirdparty_text: Videos, maps and other content hosted by external services.
service_posthog_text: Pages viewed and clicks (clicked text masked). Without consent: nothing stored on your device. With consent: a visitor identifier kept in a cookie.
disclosure_none: This website uses no audience measurement or tracking tool.
disclosure_consent_note: The cookie below is only set after your agreement, given through the banner shown on your first visit. You can change it at any time.
disclosure_exempt_note: The services below set no cookie and do not track visitors across websites. They do not require consent.
meta_description_default: Racing team management software: travel, hotels, roles and the race weekend timetable, on every crew member's phone.
module_management_short: Roles, racecars and meals per event
module_management_summary: Roles per car and per crew, racecar entries and meals for every event: set once, seen by the whole crew, with what is still missing before the event.
module_management_phone_alt: RaceNode Management on a phone: one item to resolve before the event, team roles, staff with a role and a meal
module_management_screen_alt: RaceNode Management: one staff without a team role to resolve before the event, team roles, staff with a role and a meal
module_logistics_summary: Flights, trains, team vehicles and hotels, room by room. Flags anyone missing a flight, a hotel or a ride, and fills bookings in from the confirmation you drop.
module_logistics_phone_alt: RaceNode Logistics on a phone: staff without departure or return travel, flagged before the event
module_logistics_screen_alt: RaceNode Logistics: three staff without departure or return travel flagged before the event, travel, accommodation and vehicles covered
module_timetable_summary: Your team schedule alongside the official sessions, briefings set once and anchored to them, and a live countdown on the screen in your box.
module_timetable_phone_alt: RaceNode Timetable on a phone: the team's race weekend schedule with the time left before each item
module_timetable_screen_alt: RaceNode Timetable: the team's Friday schedule, briefings and official sessions, with the time left before each item
module_planning_short: The whole season on one grid
module_planning_summary: Staff, racecars and trucks across the whole season on one grid, painted day by day
module_planning_summary_crew_days: , with availability posted by your own crew
module_planning_phone_alt: RaceNode Planning on a phone: a racing team's week, who is on track, travelling or at the workshop
module_planning_screen_alt: RaceNode Planning: a racing team's month on one grid, who is on track, travelling or at the workshop, day by day
